ops.oldText: without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws.
ops.newText: without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws. Each Party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York with respect to any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement.

input.comment: [Playbook] New York law already matches our accepted position, so we only added an exclusive venue in the state and federal courts in New York County. The clause is otherwise silent on forum, which leaves disputes open to being pulled into an unfamiliar or foreign venue.
input.summary: Add exclusive New York County court venue to the New York governing law clause.
